ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Gender and Equality? Work, suffrage, and sports in 20th Century America Topic: This course uses "Reacting to the Past," role-playing games to learn about contentious times and debates, first in Greenwich Village, New York where immigrants, artists, suffragists, and anarchists argued to create a new world and live as new women and new men. Then, we will move to the 1990s, Title IX, and the complicated relationships betwee sport, equality, and education in American society.
